en.addDesc: Add self-hosted SearXNG or any supported engine: provide an ID to seamlessly join the pool.
en.desc: Manage API keys and routing for search/fetch backends. Keys stay in local settings.yaml and take effect immediately. Multiple keys per engine: one per line.
en.placeholder: leave empty to keep current; multiple keys: one per line or comma-separated
en.strategyDesc: Failover attempts backends in order of priority; Rotate distributes search requests by weight across healthy engines to optimize free quotas.
en.tipDesc: Search and fetch hit engine APIs directly with 0 model token cost. AI can use web_search_from(query, source) to retry with specific engines if needed.
en.tipTitle: 💡 Zero Model Token & AI Source Switching
en.weightHint: Traffic distribution weight in rotate mode (1-10)
